captions.instagram:
How does virtual production work?

The desert behind the actor is a wall of LEDs, redrawn 24 times a second for exactly where the camera stands. Step inside a working LED volume: move the tracked camera, change the sunset, pull focus onto the pixels, and move a mountain from the brain bar.

→ Virtual production puts a small real set inside a curved wall of LED screens.
→ The camera is tracked, and the patch of wall it sees is redrawn from its exact spot.
→ Switch tracking off and the far mountains slide with the wall, like a painted backdrop.
→ The wall is also the light: change the place, and the actor and chrome change with it.
→ A green screen throws green light and green reflections, fixed later by hand.

Play with it yourself. It's free and open source: glassbox-production-fd52.up.railway.app/virtualprodclear (link in bio)

youtubeLong.title: How does virtual production work? (interactive explainer)
youtubeLong.description:
The desert behind the actor is a wall of LEDs, redrawn 24 times a second for exactly where the camera stands. Step inside a working LED volume: move the tracked camera, change the sunset, pull focus onto the pixels, and move a mountain from the brain bar.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox-production-fd52.up.railway.app/e/virtualprodclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/virtualprodclear

In this video:
• A room made of screens. An LED volume is a curved wall and ceiling of LED panels around a small real set.
• The wall is drawn for one camera. The camera is tracked by infrared cameras on the truss.
• The screen is also the light. Millions of LEDs light the set with whatever they show.
• Dots, delay and limits. The wall is a grid of LEDs about 2.3 to 2.9 mm apart.
• The brain bar. Engine operators, tracking and screen technicians sit at the brain bar.
• From rear projection to Hyderabad. Rear projection put filmed roads behind cars from 1930.

Glassbox opens one box a day: an interactive model of how something works, plus the code behind it.
